papers.title_en: IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation
papers.authors: Jiaxing Chen, Zizheng Yan, Jingyu Zhuang, Jinwei Chen, Shuguang Cui, Guanying Chen, Qingnan Fan
papers.evidence: 利用冻结几何基础模型进行度量几何估计的测试时适应
papers.tldr: 单目图像恢复度量3D几何因透视投影歧义而病态，现有模型虽用内参却未用于适应监督。IntriAdapt把相机内参作为输出侧几何验证器，用点云视线与内参视线的闭式残差驱动测试时适应，仅在冻结几何基础模型上优化轻量LoRA。它无需深度传感器或外部先验，适应短视频后可泛化到同相机其他序列。在十个单图与七个序列基准、多个基础模型上，它一致优于未适应和oracle内参基线，提升度量精度与相对几何。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering metric 3D geometry from images is fundamentally ill-posed due to perspective projection ambiguity. Current geometry models incorporate supplied or predicted intrinsics during inference, but do not use them to supervise model adaptation. To refine these predictions, test-time adaptation (TTA) typically relies on external depth measurements. In this paper, we instead use camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier. Comparing the point cloud's viewing rays with those defined by the known intrinsics yields a direct measure of geometric inconsistency. We propose \textit{IntriAdapt}, a TTA framework that minimizes this closed-form geometric residual. By optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, our method aligns the prediction with the specific camera model without depth sensors or external priors. We further extend this approach to video sequences, demonstrating that adapting a short sequence generalizes to other sequences captured by the same camera. The adapted model processes held-out images in a feed-forward pass, without repeating optimization for each frame. Experiments on ten single-image and seven sequence benchmarks across multiple base models show that \textit{IntriAdapt} consistently outperforms both unadapted and oracle-intrinsics baselines in metric accuracy and relative geometry.

papers.title_en: Visual Memory and Textual Alignment for Cross-Modal Few-Shot Segmentation
papers.authors: Tianqi Wei, Zhi Chen, Xin Yu, Scott Chapman, Zi Huang
papers.evidence: 基于SAM 3的文本引导少样本分割
papers.tldr: 小样本分割旨在用少量标注样本分割目标，但SAM 3在专业领域仍受语义提示与视觉表示对齐不佳制约。ViTA-SAM基于SAM 3引入视觉记忆模块，将支持特征与对应掩码编码为支持感知的视觉引导，同时用文本编码器提取语义先验。它通过跨模态对齐模块让文本特征以记忆增强的视觉表示为条件，并用伪标签细化策略以查询预测更新记忆。多基准实验显示其总体性能最佳，平均mIoU较最强对比方法提升超过5%，验证了视觉记忆与文本对齐的互补价值。
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment target objects with limited annotated examples. Recent studies have begun to explore large foundation models to improve generalization for this task. In particular, SAM 3 provides strong visual representations and supports text-guided segmentation. However, its performance remains limited in specialized domains, where semantic prompts and visual representations are often poorly aligned. To address this challenge, we propose ViTA-SAM, a framework built upon SAM 3 that integrates visual memory and textual features through cross-modal alignment. Specifically, we construct a visual memory module that encodes support features together with their corresponding masks, providing support-aware visual guidance for query prediction. In parallel, we leverage the text encoder of SAM 3 to extract semantic features as complementary priors. To bridge the gap between semantic and visual representations, we introduce a cross-modal alignment module that conditions textual features on memory-enhanced visual representations, yielding more consistent and visually grounded predictions. In addition, we propose a pseudo-label refinement strategy that updates the memory with predicted query masks, enabling query-adaptive representation learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ViTA-SAM achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, outperforming the strongest competing method by over 5% in average mIoU.
